column2: three new heroes each expose four skills and correct passive counts
Lucius party shield refreshes and expires without stacking
Lucius heals lowest health ratio and gives finite defensive buff
Divine Strike hits nearby targets and knocks down, not far rear
Blessed Shield reduces incoming damage and resists control until expiry
ready ultimate ends Lucius shield stance early
Fawkes Confine selects highest attack and removes target from combat for duration
Purification damages only targetable enemies and removes positive effects not debuffs
Silver Bolt modifies normal shots only and adds debuffed-target bonus
Raine Cripple marks all available enemies and boosts incoming damage
Raine Barrage schedules five shots to each stream, may share target
Lock On applies offensive buffs on ally hit, no base heal, refresh not stack
Exploit passive scales with missing health only for Raine
banish prevents queued hits and does not count as death
